notes: CDRH device letter for the SNOO Smart Sleeper/SNOO Hospital Bundle infant bassinet: unapproved changes/modifications requiring new 510(k) submissions (X-Small/X-Large Sleep Sacks, hospital-use marketing), Quality System Regulation (21 CFR 820) complaint-handling, design-control, and CAPA failures, and unreported corrections/removals. contamination_present is true based on complaint reports of stained/soiled, unsanitary refurbished devices shipped to customers (not a microbial finding at a manufacturing facility). recall_concern is true because the letter's 'Corrections and Removals' section addresses an unreported device correction (replacement shipments) under 21 CFR Part 806. linked_to_complaints is left false since no genus-species organism is named. No FEI is stated (device letter; recipient address itself has a redacted line).
